sentences: `v_mul_hi_*24`: the high 32 bits of the 48-bit product of the low 24 bits, zero-extended (u24) or sign-extended from bit 23 (i24); the high halves of `v_mul_u32_u24` / `v_mul_i32_i24`.
`v_lshrrev_b64` / `v_ashrrev_i64`: the pair (or a 64-bit constant) shifted right by S0 & 63, logically or arithmetically, through the `v_lshlrev_b64` code.

`v_qsad_pk_u16_u8` / `v_mqsad_pk_u16_u8`: D.u16[k] = (S2.u16[k] + byte SAD of the 32-bit window S0[8k+31:8k] against S1) & 0xFFFF; the m form skips bytes where S1's byte is 0; `clamp` raises `Unsupported`.

CPU-checked by `tests/semantic/test_alu_mul_hi_24.py`, `test_alu_shift_b64.py`, `test_alu_qsad.py`; run on NVIDIA by reviewers (`v_mul_hi_*24`: RTX 5090 and RTX 5070 in #440; `v_qsad`/`v_mqsad`: 24 cases bit-exact on an RTX 3060 in #623).

**Not measured on RDNA2.** **Hardware-verified on RDNA2** (`gfx1035`, wave32 and wave64 via `tools/int_hw_probe.py --oracle both`, SHADER-137), and on native `gfx1036` (AMD Radeon Graphics) with 0 mismatches across signed/unsigned products, shifts, and sliding windows.
